assertions.assertion: The denial carries reason code CO-197.
The denied service is CPT code 93229.
CPT 93229 corresponds to mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring.
The clinical indication note documents recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness.
The note raises concern for paroxysmal supraventricular tachycardia and underlying atrial fibrillation.
The submitted diagnosis codes are I48.91 and I47.1.
The diagnosis codes I48.91 and I47.1 are consistent with the documented clinical concern for atrial fibrillation and paroxysmal SVT.
The note states the symptoms are intermittent in nature and there is a need for continuous rhythm correlation over an extended period.
The note states mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring is ordered to capture arrhythmic events and guide further management.
The denial is authorization-based (required precertification/authorization was not obtained).
The provider has the right to request reconsideration/appeal of the determination.
The claim pertains to a single episode of care.
